title: Monthly books close
goal: Close the month {month} for venture {venture} from connector data only: revenue, refunds, fees, payouts, ad spend, model spend; nothing estimated.

steps.title: Gather the figures and write the close
steps.brief: For {month}: read stripe.charges, stripe.refunds, stripe.payouts (sinceDays covering the month) and, if a Park Store or Notice board is in your zone, shopify.orders / etsy.receipts and meta_ads.insights / google_ads.metrics. Write outbox/books/close-{month}-{venture}.md: revenue (paid charges or paid orders, say which source), refunds, Stripe fees (only if the charges carry them), payouts, ad spend, and model spend from ledger.read (scope venture, detail days, the month's days), which also gives the results engine's own revenue, refunds, fees and ad spend rows to reconcile against what you read from the connectors; a difference is written down, not smoothed over. Every figure cites its source and its count of rows; a figure no connector holds is written as "no data", never 0 and never estimated. End with the three largest items of the month.
